scenario: new semester grade sheet published on the academic portal, log in to view
subject: Grade Sheet Published for New Semester
body:
Dear [Student Name],

We hope this message finds you well.

The grade sheet for the new semester has been published on our academic portal. Please log in to review your grades at your earliest convenience.

To access the grade sheet:

1. Go to the IIT Hyderabad Portal: https://portal.training.invalid/verify
2. Enter your credentials to view your updated grades.

If you have any issues logging in, please contact the Helpdesk at helpdesk@training.invalid.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,  
The IIT Hyderabad Academic Office
